narration:0:1460475001:0.text: These days, thanks to your efforts, nearly everyone in Sal'thorin has heard of the clinic—and your uncanny ability to cure just about anything.

say:1:1460477001:1.text: You've done a great job. The clinic's name is everywhere now.

say:1:1460477001:1.female: You've done a great job. The clinic's name is everywhere now.

say:2:1460477002:1.text: Thanks to you, those self-proclaimed heroes and adventurers who were driving the guards up the wall have finally gone quiet.

say:9:1460477008:1.text: To be honest, the hardest thing is telling who's actually sick and who's just being dramatic.
